_comment: Hand-written additions to the FIA-derived weekend data (scripts/update-weekend.mjs merges them in). By season, then FIA event name, lowercased. stintCap: Pirelli's max laps per tyre set when the FIA PDF only shows it as a graphic. rules: plain-English notes for the Race Brief's Rules tab; tag is a short label, doc the FIA document number it comes from.

rules.title: No dawdling between the Safety Car lines
rules.body: Every qualifying lap has a maximum time, in- and out-laps included. Teams get it after FP2; breaches are investigated after the session.

rules.title: Pit entry: keep right of the bollard
rules.body: Passing to its right counts as entering the pit lane.

rules.title: Practice starts after FP2
rules.body: After the chequered flag, drivers may do two extra laps only to stop on the grid and practise starts.
